shellCommands.command: cat package.json; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

for f in lib/products.ts next.config.ts app/product/\[slug\]/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/globals.css app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; grep -ril "view.transition\|viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head

grep -n -i -B2 -A20 "transitionTypes\|viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -120; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ | grep -i view; ls node_modules/react/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/react/package.json node_modules/next/package.json

cd node_modules/next/dist/compiled; ls | grep -i '^react$\|^react-exp'; grep -o '"version": *"[^"]*"' react/package.json react-experimental/package.json 2>/dev/null; grep -c "ViewTransition" react/cjs/react.production.js react-experimental/cjs/react.production.js 2>/dev/null; cd /workspace; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60

cd node_modules/next/dist/compiled; grep -o 'exports.ViewTransition\|exports.unstable_ViewTransition\|exports.addTransitionType\|exports.unstable_addTransitionType' react/cjs/react.production.js; grep -o '"version": "[^"]*"' react/package.json; grep -o 'ViewTransition[^;]\{0,40\}' ../../types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -o '"version": "[^"]*"' /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo TSC=$?; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/; curl -s localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'Classic Sneakers' | head -1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "detail %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
